config.novelty_triple_selection_method: seeded random sample per question (seed derived from sha256(seed:question_id)), not the earlier deterministic alphabetical-first-N selection -- see ADR-016 addendum, 2026-09-05 follow-up
config.relevance_match_method: case-insensitive substring match of triple head/tail against the question stem and each answer option's text

hit_definition: >=1 of the question's linked entities resolves to a PrimeKG node (kg_node_id is not None) AND >=1 triple is retrieved from that node's subgraph. This is a PERMISSIVE, question-level definition: with ~74 linked entities/question and only ~11% of individual linked entities resolving (see entity_level_mapping_rate), a question-level hit is close to an arithmetic guarantee (see naive_expected_hit_rate_under_independence) rather than evidence that PrimeKG covers 96% of MedQA content. Read aggregate_hit_rate together with entity_level_mapping_rate, never alone.
